title: Run record
description: One measured run. The efficiency observer cites these rather than impressions (Goal G58). Records the SHAPE of a run and never its content: no claims, no client material, no file contents, so a record is safe to read on any surface.

task.description: One line: what the run was for.

review_rounds.description: Per unit. A value equal to the cap means that unit never converged.

rework.description: Units reopened after being called done: the expensive failure the round count hides.

degraded_checks.description: Gates that could not run, and why. A clean run with three gates unable to execute passed less than it appears to have.
